sources.title: facebook/mms-tts-dhi — AICHINA.news | AI China News
sources.snippet: This is a text-to-speech (TTS) model developed by Meta as part of the Massively Multilingual Speech (MMS) project, specifically for the Dhivehi language (spoken in the Maldives). It can convert written Dhivehi text into natural-sounding speech, making it useful for voice applications, accessibility tools, and content creation in that language.
